vol_sato — 3D feature op

• Data kinds: voxel → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_sato(vol, scales=(1, 2, 3), black_ridges=False) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import volops; volops.vol_sato(vol, scales=(1, 2, 3), black_ridges=False), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("vol_sato"))

उपयोग

3-D Sato tubeness — दो eigenvalues वाला सरल line filter।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Per scale, from eigenvalues in algebraic order e1 >= e2 >= e3 a bright curvilinear (tube) structure has e2, e3 < 0 and the tubeness is sqrt(e2 * e3) there (0 elsewhere); black_ridges=True uses the two most *positive* eigenvalues for dark tubes. The maximum over scales is normalised to [0, 1].

Cheaper and less selective than vol_frangi (it does not explicitly suppress plate- or blob-like structure), but a robust, well-cited tube detector. Reference: Sato et al., Medical Image Analysis 1998.
